'''2021 Worlds Throwback Top 8 Kendall Halman DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kendall Halman]] at the [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Kendall Halman]]
* '''Event:''' [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:21WRPR2 Halman DS HD.txt |Download]]
